_meta.note: elements/elementChildren/attributes/streamValues/streamSummaries mirror the PI Web API responses in §4. chlorine_data, pressure_data, water_consumption and communication_status mirror the Postgres tables the §5 cron jobs write. 'demographics' is NOT part of the PI guide - PI carries no population, household, supply-duration or water-source figures (water_source repeats the village's scheme source and is a placeholder) - and is seeded here so the dashboards have a single data source instead of hardcoded values. 'asset_details' is likewise outside the guide: pipe schedules, reservoir category and operator contacts come from the asset register, not from PI.
